svg.title: The largest LL-37 trial missed its main goal
svg.desc: The largest LL-37 trial missed its main goal. All patients (primary analysis, 144): LL-37, lower strength 26.5%, LL-37, higher strength 24.7%, Placebo 25.3%. No difference: p = 0.45 and 0.53 vs placebo. Post hoc: wounds 10 cm² or larger (66): LL-37, lower strength 28.1%, LL-37, higher strength 19.6%, Placebo 8.1%. Lower strength vs placebo p = 0.046; not planned.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
